admin.arithmetic: Version checked_add occurs after optional byte writes; simple role/cap/reset assignments have no arithmetic. Intervals are u64 wire fields interpreted as signed i64 by consumers.
admin.authority: Stored admin Signer through Admin; no second-party acceptance signature for role changes.
admin.cpi_identity_forwarding: Only update_global_params emits log/self-CPI; otherwise unused unchecked program account is not a spending target.
admin.error_rollback_order: Context parsing precedes body; update failure after writes requires transaction rollback. Event CPI can fail after log emission. Failed logs do not prove committed state.
admin.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Writable admin and typed GlobalParams; global-params PDA and has_one admin; event PDA; CheckedSystemProgram. No universal alias prohibition is inferred from derive.
admin.reconstruction_fence: Five GlobalParams roles unknown; permission policy and historical macro expansion unproved; no original equivalence from candidate declarations.
admin.serialization: Fixed-length slices and Borsh options; account exit is framework-owned. Actual serialized ranges reviewed; no native Rust layout inference.

bootstrap.arithmetic: FeeRecipient index<8 is a body check after context init CPIs. No amount arithmetic in either body.
bootstrap.authority: A signing payer chooses GlobalParams.admin only at init. Fee-recipient payer has no has_one admin restriction.
bootstrap.cpi_identity_forwarding: System/ATA init CPIs are generated; CheckedSystemProgram and Program<AssociatedToken>; no caller-selected beneficiary stored in FeeRecipient.
bootstrap.error_rollback_order: FeeRecipient out-of-range index fails after allocation attempts; atomic rollback needed. Existing initialized PDA must be rejected by framework.
bootstrap.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Canonical init PDA, fixed space and typed owner via framework. FeeRecipient also requires existing global PDA, native mint and legacy token ID. Alias checks delegated to init framework.
bootstrap.reconstruction_fence: These two allowed initializers are distinct from excluded initialize_mayhem_state. Live bootstrap state/policy and init macro implementation remain unclosed.
bootstrap.serialization: 254-byte GlobalParams / 42-byte FeeRecipient initial allocation; body stores only admin or bump/index; zero-init premise is framework-owned.

burn.arithmetic: Reads full u64 token balance, stores it as burned_amount; no cumulative arithmetic; Clock unwrap can panic.
burn.authority: Permissionless, guarded by end_timestamp<=Clock and status!=Ended; no global pause or administrator requirement.
burn.cpi_identity_forwarding: Interface token burn of full vault amount signed by sol-vault. Pump/global accounts are consumed but no Pump CPI in body; event program unchecked.
burn.error_rollback_order: Deadline before repeated-burn guard; token CPI then burned amount, two separate Clock reads/log and self-event, status Ended last. Atomic failure premise retained.
burn.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Typed MayhemState mint-seeded PDA, mutable mint/vault and Pump curve PDA/owner; sol-vault PDA. Stored state.mint not independently compared; canonical seed binds supplied mint.
burn.reconstruction_fence: Six saved genuine-snapshot comparisons are finite inherited evidence; excluded initializer/lifecycle never assumed proved.
burn.serialization: Strict BondingCurve codec differs from trade padded SellCurve. MayhemStatus discriminant and bool validity delegated to Borsh.

codec.arithmetic: Fixed buffer sizes and offsets safe; short data padded only for selected codecs; defaulted reserves may later hit arithmetic rejection.
codec.authority: Pure codec/owner helper; no user authority or transfers. Calling typed account must enforce owner separately.
codec.cpi_identity_forwarding: No CPI; no external account forwarding.
codec.error_rollback_order: Returns deserialization/serialization errors before callers operate; partial writer failure is not a successful complete account write.
codec.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Owner constants fixed to Pump/AMM. Decode checks content only; no PDA, writable or uniqueness checks inside codec.
codec.reconstruction_fence: Codec convenience is retained reconstruction behavior, not proof of valid historical account state or whole layout identity.
codec.serialization: Explicit discriminator/boolean/trailing-data and cursor behavior described per function. Macro-derived Borsh internals and error provenance unclosed.

error.arithmetic: Converts MathOverflow enum only; no arithmetic.
error.error_rollback_order: Caller selects timing and rollback; this helper simply returns the error value.
error.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: No account access or alias effect.
error.reconstruction_fence: Non-initializer error ABI differs in retained study; same source-level error is not raw body/data identity.
error.serialization: Framework Error representation delegated to Into conversion.

extend.arithmetic: Rent minimum(new_size).saturating_sub(balance); equal/larger sizes return without funding. No shrink.
extend.cpi_identity_forwarding: Checked System transfer only when rent shortfall>0; fixed event PDA but unchecked program account for self-event framework.
extend.error_rollback_order: Transfer precedes resize, then Clock and log/self-event; later failure must roll back earlier changes.
extend.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Target mutable and Mayhem-owned plus recognized discriminator; no PDA or full state decode. User is not explicitly mut, so funding additionally relies on actual writable privilege and CPI runtime checks.
extend.reconstruction_fence: Permissionless extension of owned recognized accounts is observed; no invented source restriction or initializer review.
extend.serialization: Capacities 318/74/170, not proof of additional fields. Resize behavior/zero-fill delegated to AccountInfo/runtime.

framework.arithmetic: Only split_first length check and vector construction; no financial arithmetic.
framework.authority: System wrapper itself grants no authority.
framework.cpi_identity_forwarding: No invocation; helper returns the same account/info/key or meta with requested/fixed flags as specified.
framework.error_rollback_order: Missing keys errors; wrong ID InvalidProgramId with account_name before underlying executable validation; allocation or caller failures remain external.
framework.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: ID equality precedes Program::try_from executable check; readonly flattened meta shapes. Empty duplicate list is for this program wrapper only, not a global alias guarantee.
framework.reconstruction_fence: Delegated Program traits and AccountsExit default not expanded. Compatibility adapter does not prove historical dependency identity.
framework.serialization: try_accounts consumes exactly one account before validation; no data decoding, persistent state or account serialization body.

sweep.arithmetic: Aggregate cap inductively maintained when arithmetic succeeds. Native rent subtraction and destination addition can overflow/underflow. previous+total-before_total can overflow at intermediate addition even if final mathematical result fits.
sweep.authority: Caller wrapper chooses stored trader or admin and its destination; helper is private and trusts those callers.
sweep.cpi_identity_forwarding: Token transfer uses stored fee-recipient index/bump signing. Fixed legacy token target in wrappers; token program validates authority/mint for nonzero amount. Native lamports move directly from owned account to authorized destination.
sweep.error_rollback_order: Sequential token transfer, native movement, counter update, optional timestamp, exit. Zero token amount skips CPI validation. Later errors need transaction rollback across earlier pairs.
sweep.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Exactly 16 remaining entries, eight typed recipient/token pairs; no per-pair PDA/ATA/unique/writable preflight. Runtime checks and nonzero transfer authority enforce only the paths reached. Duplicate pairs re-decode after explicit exit.
sweep.reconstruction_fence: No claim that arbitrary matching owned accounts are creatable; alias/reachability/dependency and cumulative counter bounds unresolved. Sixteen accounts is not eight distinct canonical recipients.
sweep.serialization: Opaque 32 bytes contain native timestamp/counter at offsets 0/8, stable counter/timestamp at 16/24; explicit recipient.exit each iteration.

trade.arithmetic: u64 reserve products fit u128; reference*tolerance checked; zero vt rejected. bps complement can panic above 10000; zero effective quote can reach divide unwrap. Actual balance deltas unsigned and signed counters checked. Buy compares positive i128 low-u64 limbs strictly.
trade.authority: Configured mutable trader Signer via global has_one; all six bodies check pause, interval, deadline, then threshold on status transition.
trade.cpi_identity_forwarding: Fixed PUMP_ID or AMM_ID; exact vectors and flags in cpi-contracts.json, sol-vault seeds. Unchecked fee/global/creator accounts are forwarded, not locally authenticated. No ctx.remaining_accounts forwarding.
trade.error_rollback_order: Timestamp/status writes precede price and CPI. Post-CPI reload/counter/risk/event failure requires atomic rollback. Legacy sell propagates CPI error; other trade CPIs map to 6008/6010; successful nested logs can survive rejected transaction.
trade.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: Global/state/vault PDAs and typed owners; base vault ATA. External curve PDA on Pump routes; AMM pool/config typed but local pool/mint/vault relationships delegated to AMM. No universal disjointness from declarations.
trade.reconstruction_fence: Synthetic trade states do not prove live quote policy, all extensions, lifecycle, cross-program constraints or original whole-file equality. Mayhem sell_v2 review does not inspect excluded Pump sell_v2 body.
trade.serialization: Padded SellCurve or SwapPool with strict GlobalConfig; reloads after CPI for balances. Fixed SellEvent contains side and native/generic quote fields; derived serializer not independently expanded.

withdraw.arithmetic: Signed last+interval with release overflow checks; zero last or interval bypasses rate predicate. Zero amount still updates timestamp.
withdraw.authority: Writable stored admin Signer via has_one; no pause gate and no trader access.
withdraw.cpi_identity_forwarding: Native uses checked System and sol-vault seeds; quote calls anchor_spl::token::transfer with interface key. Retained evidence says legacy-token helper target; interface acceptance is not Token2022 withdrawal success proof.
withdraw.error_rollback_order: Timestamp written before transfer, so failed CPI relies on rollback. Quote ATA may initialize during parsing before rate check.
withdraw.pda_owner_signer_writable_alias: GlobalParams typed/PDA/mutable; sol-vault PDA/mutable unchecked owner. System CPI enforces native source ownership; quote ATAs constrain mint/authority/program via framework.
withdraw.reconstruction_fence: Source comments and retained evidence support these oddities as observed behavior; no new live reachability or complete original ABI proof.
withdraw.serialization: Timestamp writes into exact 8-byte ranges, no deployment-counter reconciliation. Framework exit and token decoder not expanded.

boundary: Review conclusions are manual; verifier checks provenance/coverage/contracts, not security truth.
